source: IEX historical exchange data via Roy-jpeg/to-the-moon-data
adjustment: Raw IEX first/last regular-session round-lot trades; unadjusted for corporate actions and dividends. Open/close only.
limitations: IEX exchange only, not consolidated prices. Open/close represent first/last regular-session round-lot trade.
Raw unadjusted open and close; no high/low fields. No dividends or corporate action adjustments.
Fixed chosen universe has selection and survivorship bias; not point-in-time constituent membership.
January 2026 onwards chosen to avoid known November 2025 NFLX 10:1 split.
Data is mirrored from a third-party public repository; not independently reconciled with a consolidated feed.
All 20 selected tickers have 201 common valid sessions (2026-01-02 through 2026-10-20). No missing or nonpositive open/close values, duplicate dates, or overnight jumps exceeding 40% in this sample.
